title: Dallas Choice - BassKing
htmlContent:
Born in Elgin, and grown around Chicagoland, Dallas Lee Anthony Zabran, aka Dallas Choice, is an up-and-coming rapper looking to build a rich music history for himself. By 20, he had started rapping and promoting with friends. After writing hundreds of raps, he decided to release his music slowly. He currently owns three albums and several singles. Dallas Choice lately took the globe by storm as he again revealed another hit single titled “BassKing.” 

“BassKing” is a banger, quickly accumulating traction due to his raspy magnetic technique, and his high-level skill in clever rhymes makes us want to press the replay button repeatedly. His delivery is especially impressive, as his unique voice drifts smoothly with lively sounds in the background.

Dallas Choice “BassKing” is now available on all streaming platforms!
